description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). Interactive: show one of your drafts here. Call it whenever the engineer asks to show, see or open the preview, to show it here, or what the draft looks like (for example: "show me the preview", "show it here", "can I see the draft", "open the preview", "what does it look like"). A read: the draft as techfabric.com renders it, with its last checks (each marked as one the engineer may publish past or one that must pass) and whether Publish may run, rendered inline as the draft app where the host shows MCP Apps. In any host its text starts with the preview link: show it to the engineer. Never fetch the preview link yourself or rebuild the page as an artifact or HTML: this is the preview.

editing.description: The draft app only, never an agent: true while the engineer has unsaved edits in its Edit tab (takes or renews the app's edit hold), false when they save, discard or leave it (lets go). It changes no text; with it the answer is the hold, not the preview

instance.description: The draft app only: its view's own id, with editing

wait_seconds.description: While the preview builds: how long to wait for it before answering (default 0, most 25)

name: preview_draft

checks.description: The last check run on the draft, each item marked as one the engineer may publish past or one that must pass; null before any

cockpit.description: The writing cockpit: one status, one next step, the to-do cards and any open redline

editing.description: With editing (the draft app's hold): whether an edit is under way

held.description: With editing: whether the app holds the draft for the engineer's edit

preview_current.description: False while a save is still being committed or its preview rebuilt

preview_source.description: Which page the app shows: the published page, the draft's own preview, the live post standing in for a revision's, or none yet

preview_url.description: The draft's preview (the live page once published): show it to the engineer

progress.description: Approved, merged, deployed, live_url and indexed, once it is on its way

publish.description: Whether Publish may run now, and why not

steps.description: Where the draft is, step by step (the same steps the progress notifications name): done, active (under way now), pending or failed

why.description: With editing: why the hold was not taken

title: Preview your draft
